senses.gloss: m. (לָקַט) gleaner, a sort of client, retainer.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 46b:4">Shebu. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>שכירו ולְקִיטוֹ מאי</he> how about his hired laborer or his client (may they take the oath)?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:3:4">Y. Erub. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> top <he>שמשו ולקיטו</he> his (the gentile’s) attendant or client.

<cite ref="Ketubot 54a:16">Keth. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>וחילופה בל׳</he> (Ar. <he>בלקוט</he>) and the reverse is the law (as to deducting from his wages the outlay for his garments) concerning the client; <he>וכן בל׳</he> the same is the law &c.
